# Buttercup Advertising Studio

> Best creative branding, brand strategy, visual identity, 3D packaging architecture, and advertising agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Led by Creative Director & Founder Sneha Vakta Shah. Serving ambitious founders across India, United States, United Kingdom, UAE (Dubai), Canada, and Singapore. Rated 4.9/5.0 based on 84+ verified client engagements.

Buttercup Advertising Studio (BAS) engineers category-defining brand identities, commercial brand narratives, shelf-dominating packaging design, and modern interactive web experiences. We combine senior creative directorship with agile sprints, eliminating agency bureaucracy and delivering measurable market dominance.

## Global & Local Geographic Reach (GEO)
- **Headquarters**: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (Coordinates: 23.022505° N, 72.571362° E, Postal Code: 382425)
- **Gujarat Regional Coverage**: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Bhavnagar, Jamnagar.
- **Pan-India National Footprint**: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Jaipur, Indore.
- **International Client Hubs**: United States (New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles), United Kingdom (London), United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver), Singapore, Australia (Sydney, Melbourne).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Brand Strategy & Positioning](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/brand-strategy/): Market whitespace discovery, competitor analysis, audience personas, brand manifestos, and brand architecture.
- [Visual Identity & Logo Design](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/visual-identity/): Bespoke corporate logos, custom typography, Figma design systems, Pantone color palettes, and living brand books.
- [Packaging Design & 3D CGI Architecture](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/visual-identity/): Retail shelf dominance ("The 3-Second Shelf Battle"), structural die-lines, 3D photo-realistic CGI renders (Blender/Cinema 4D), luxury tactile finishes (embossing, hot foil stamping, spot UV), and FSSAI/FDA regulatory compliance.
- [Marketing Communication & Campaigns](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/marketing-communication/): 360-degree omnichannel launch campaigns, social media creative direction, outdoor hoardings, and B2B distributor collateral.
- [Creative Web Design & Interactive Development](https://buttercup.in/): High-performance, 60fps/120fps hardware-accelerated websites, mobile-first responsive architecture, and conversion-optimized digital experiences.
- [Product Base Industries](https://buttercup.in/pages/industries/product-base/): FMCG & Packaged Foods, Ayurvedic Wellness, Beauty & Cosmetics, Luxury Jewelry, Pharmaceuticals, Apparel, and Industrial Manufacturing.
- [Service Base Industries](https://buttercup.in/pages/industries/service-base/): Real Estate & Architecture, SaaS & FinTech, Healthcare, Hospitality, Venture Capital, and Consulting.

## Pricing & Investment Tiers
- **Brand Strategy Sprint**: Starting from ₹49,999 ($699) — Complete market positioning, brand story, and tone-of-voice.
- **Visual Identity System**: Starting from ₹74,999 ($999) — Bespoke logo marks, typography, Figma design system, and brand guidelines.
- **3D Packaging Design**: Starting from ₹59,999 ($799) — Structural die-lines, CGI renders, print-ready files, and shelf-impact engineering.
- **Marketing Communication Campaign**: Starting from ₹99,999 ($1,299) — Omnichannel creative launch and digital collateral.
